cases.surface: The surrounding events are clear, but the last observable action that belonged to me has not been pinned down.
I described the context thoroughly, yet what I personally did at the end is still absent.
We know what happened before and after, but not the concrete response I myself made.
I want you to take over the judgement and tell me exactly what to choose.
Use this invented case for testing only; it is not an event from my life.
What hidden assessment does my colleague have of me beyond anything I can directly observe?
Tell me the other person's secret view of me, not anything about my own actions.
Is this likely to end positively for me during the next few weeks?
A reversible experiment was ready, but I kept adding alternatives instead of beginning it.
The important task required action, yet I distracted myself with something peripheral.
I answered later than usual, reviewed it once, and then let the matter rest.
My response came late; after one check I did not reopen the issue.
I waited before replying, looked once more, and then moved on.
I moved toward acting, stepped back, then re-entered the same review loop repeatedly without new evidence.
